article.body_preview:
RANGPUR, Oct 30, 2022 (BSS) - The government has fixed an all-time record

target of producing 23,39,930 tonnes of potato from 92,675 hectares of land

for all five districts in Rangpur agriculture region during the current Rabi

season.

Officials of the Department of Agricultural Extension (DAE) said farmers

have started sowing potato seeds after harvesting short duration varieties of

Aman rice to harvest those from late November and earn more profits like in

the previous years.
